findings.title: TOCTOU hardening on openSession is exemplary triple-defense
findings.evidence: CashDrawerService::openSession L75-109 — (1) Cache::lock(3s block) per (branch,user), (2) DB::transaction + lockForUpdate on existing-session probe, (3) UNIQUE partial index migration 2026_05_10_020000 on (branch_id, opened_by_user_id) WHERE status='open'. LockTimeoutException downgraded to 409 with explicit log line [iter15-P0-09]. This pattern should be the project-wide template for any 'one active row per (scope, owner)' constraint.
findings.action: Document this pattern in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md as the canonical concurrent-create defense recipe.

findings.title: Orphan OPEN session #4 (user_id=3) left by prior agent persists for ~9 minutes
findings.evidence: DB query confirmed session #4 opened by user_id=3 at 14:27:34 still status='open' at 14:36 — pre-existed our run, no operational error. CashOverviewController::resolveOpenCashSession falls back to it when admin browses without ?branch_id= filter (Wave X-C round-1 C-003 design). Tomorrow's Z-cron close at 23:59 will reconcile it via fiscal:close-all-active-branches, but the user_id=3 record will show variance 0€ + no closer attribution unless manually cleaned.
findings.impact: Cosmetic — does NOT corrupt NF525 chain. Operator confusion when 'Vue caisse unifiée' shows a drawer for a different user.
findings.recommendation: V1.0.2 — add 'Sessions caissier orphelines (>4h sans mouvement)' housekeeping section to /admin/cash-sessions-report. Or, simpler: auto-reconcile on Z-close cron with variance=0 + reason='auto: drawer abandonné sans mouvement'.

findings.title: Cash Overview reconciliation card does NOT visualize the Z-cron close anchor
findings.evidence: K2-HEAL-06 appends z_report.closed to audit_logs at every Z close (verified at AppServiceProvider.php:77). The card disappears the moment the drawer is closed/reconciled — operator cannot see 'today's Z report was anchored at HH:MM with chain prev_hash=XXXX' in the same surface. The dashboard widget 'Dernier rapport Z' (verified at /admin/dashboard 'Aucune donnée' state today) is a separate panel that's not cross-linked.
